# Exceptions for .github/scripts/repo_hygiene.py.
#
# Format:  <path> <check-name>   # why
#
# check-name is one of: secret-filename, google-api-key, aws-access-key-id,
# github-pat, private-key-block, slack-token.
#
# Every entry here is a thing the scanner is right about. Keep the reason
# current, and delete the line the moment it stops being true.

# HANDOFF-auth-security.md was deleted in ada49c1, so its allow-entry is gone
# per this file's own rule — the scanner has nothing left to flag. The reason it
# existed is NOT resolved and is kept here deliberately: a Google Maps key was
# committed in 807aec2 and is still in git history, reachable by anyone who can
# clone this repo. Deleting the file did not rotate the key. Rotate it in Google
# Cloud (and restrict its replacement) — then this note can go.

# mobile/google-services.json is Firebase's Android config. It is *designed* to
# be committed and shipped inside the APK — anyone with the app has it — so it
# is not a leak in the way a private key is. What matters is that the key it
# carries is restricted in Google Cloud to the package name
# `com.damiprod.ecotrack` plus the release signing SHA-1. Unrestricted, it is a
# billable key anyone can extract from the APK and use.
mobile/google-services.json secret-filename   # Firebase Android config, ships in the APK by design
mobile/google-services.json google-api-key    # ^ same. VERIFY the key is package + SHA-1 restricted in Google Cloud.
